solution:
The correct answer is __**0**__.

Swimming:

__
 
• Swimming is an individual or team racing sport that requires the use of one's entire body to move through the water.
 
• The sport takes place in pools or open water (e.g., in a sea or lake).
 
• Competitive swimming is one of the most popular Olympic sports, with varied distance events.
 
• It has 4 styles of swimming.

Explanation__:

Swimming Federation of India:

__
 
• The Swimming Federation of India (SFI) is the national governing body for aquatic sports in India.
 
• Legally, it is a non-profit association registered under the West Bengal Societies Registration Act, 1861.
 
• The federation holds elections for its office bearers every four years.
 
• The SFI currently oversees competition in the sports of swimming, masters swimming, synchronized swimming, diving, high diving, and water polo. It is affiliated with FINA, and the Asia Swimming Federation (AASF).
 
• The SFI was formed by the merger of the National Swimming Association (NSA) and the Indian Swimming Federation (ISF) in 1948.

Thus, the Swimming Federation of India was formed in the year 1948.__
